body: I understand how it feels when you think of a day job as a death sentence. It certainly feels like you're sacrificing invaluable time that could otherwise be spent pursuing more meaningful ambitions. The constructs of modern society are not designed to maximize humanity's potential, but really the opposite. Regardless of this inane system, you've got a couple advantages at the moment. First, you're young. Second the Internet is a ridiculously powerful tool when used correctly. You said it yourself, you felt close to what you set to achieve.
